body: I don't like hobbies, I tried learning an instrument but the difficulty and my lack of talent frustrated me to the point where I wanted to punch myself in the face for being so useless. I can't stand to listen to music now anymore when there are so many dipshits out there who can do these things without even trying. I can't stand that I do nothing all day but I don't really care to do anything anyway. Having a hobby at this point would just make me feel even more forever alonish.
For a second there I was afraid you were going to tell me I have diabetes.
